claims.statement: For a supplied finite signed graph, a binary vertex gauge exists exactly when every closed walk has even parity; component propagation supplies a gauge or a source-checkable odd closed walk.

claims.statement: A supplied exact real symmetric matrix admits an off-diagonal-nonpositive diagonal sign transform exactly when its nonzero-entry sign graph admits the corresponding binary gauge.
dependencies: Fixed declared basis and diagonal sign transformation grammar.
claims.limits: No classification under arbitrary basis changes or efficient sampling guarantee.

claims.statement: The finite enumerator checks canonical candidate batches and preserves an explicit suffix on UNKNOWN; continuation rechecks a contiguous prefix from zero against the same graph, complete presentation key and grammar.
dependencies: Trusted checker, collision-resistant identity hash and exact current source.
claims.limits: Exponential enumeration illustrates a reusable search protocol. New-node bounds do not bound total replay time, dollars or prove a physical adapter.
